concepts.name: Convex function
concepts.definition: A query, mutation or action a Convex deployment registers through a builder its functions folder's _generated/server exports; public ones are entrances, internal ones only the deployment's own code can call.

concepts.name: generated API
concepts.definition: The api and internal objects Convex writes into <functions folder>/_generated/api, through which code reaches a Convex function as a property path (internal.telemetry.send); the Convex plugin reads each such path as a reference to the export it names.

concepts.name: functions folder
concepts.definition: The folder Convex deploys, the nearest one above a file holding both _generated/api and _generated/server; a module's path below it is the path the generated API reaches it by.

concepts.name: Convex cron
concepts.definition: A function a convex/server cronJobs table runs on the deployment's schedule, with no caller: an entrance at the deployment's own trust.
